commitResults.messageBody:
`list` now shows every student and guardian with their ID, name,
phone and linked contacts, instead of only an unordered list of links.

Contacts are kept in a deterministic order: students, then guardians,
each by ID number (S2 before S10), then contacts without an ID in
insertion order. The order is maintained in AddressBook with a stable
sort, so the GUI list, index-based commands and the saved file agree.

Closes #47

commitResults.messageTitle: Enable assertions when running the app
commitResults.messageBody:
Java disables assertions by default, so assert statements are skipped
when the app is launched with `gradlew run`. Defensive checks written
as assertions therefore never fire during manual testing.

Turn on assertions in the Gradle run task so they are checked
whenever the app is started through Gradle.
Enable assertions in build.gradle

commitResults.messageTitle: Remove guardian links when deleting by index
commitResults.messageBody:
Deleting a student or guardian with `delete INDEX` removed the contact
but kept its guardian links. The saved file then held a link to a
missing contact, so the next launch failed to load and started with an
empty workspace, losing all data.

Let's make AddressBook#removePerson also remove the links involving the
contact's ID, and reuse it from deleteContact so that both delete paths
behave the same.

Fixes #77

commitResults.messageTitle: Add GuardianId and GuardianLink model classes
commitResults.messageBody:
F3 (link guardian to student) needs a way to represent "guardian G1
is linked to student S1" before the link command can be built.

GuardianLink is an immutable pair of StudentId and GuardianId with
value-based equality, so a duplicate link (UC02 extension 4b) can be
detected by comparing links. involves(...) lets later code find the
links to remove when a student or guardian is deleted (UC03 4a).

GuardianId mirrors StudentId (G followed by a positive number with no
leading zero) because no guardian identifier exists yet and the link
cannot be built without one. It can be reused by F2 (add guardian).
